question: Estimate the number of small businesses (kirana + small retailers) using digital payment apps (UPI QR / soundbox) in India.
idealClarificationQuestions: Definition of 'small business': individual merchants with annual revenue under ₹40 lakh? Yes.
Active acceptance (received at least 1 UPI payment in past 30 days)? Yes.
Include hawkers/street vendors with personal QRs? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Top-down: total small merchants in India → digitization penetration (urban vs rural split).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Total small retailers/merchants in India: ~70M (kiranas, vegetable vendors, paan shops, autos, salons, etc.).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Rural UPI acceptance penetration: ~30-35% = 13M (growing fast since 2024 with Bhim/PhonePe rural push, soundbox affordability).

benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~70M (kiranas, vegetable vendors, paan shops, autos, salons, etc.).
~30-35% = 13M (growing fast since 2024 with Bhim/PhonePe rural push, soundbox affordability).

calculationFlow: Rural UPI acceptance penetration: ~30-35% = 13M (growing fast since 2024 with Bhim/PhonePe rural push, soundbox affordability).
